svg.text: L49 drive-gap tolerance: slack = 5 s, sharp — then a collapse at ~5.5 s and a lottery
h40 cord, entrain .3 @ 0.7 Hz; drive OFF for G s, then back on; S per side, rolling 5 s; held = both ≥ .25

ends: s11 SL+|SR− · s22 both− · s33 re-forms

held 3/3 · open-pale = collapsed then re-held (lottery, s33) · held n = [3, 0, 1, 0, 1]
C. resume (60 s): S_R rebuilt, S_L marginal
re-formed sustained-5s 15/15 (0.1–50.8 s; tick = fast) · S_R med +.68..+.79 all
S_L marginal even in cont (SL med .23/.28/−.10) — the op point, not the gap
